# crocket

> C++26 web framework using reflection for routes, gRPC and OpenAPI, production first with built-in metrics, logging and shields.

The current release is @release@. GCC 16.2 is fully supported. See [compiler support](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/getting-started/#compiler-support) for Clang. The license is MIT. The repository is https://github.com/sean3z/crocket.

## Docs

- [Full guide](https://crocket.dev/llms-full.txt): Every v0.5 chapter, in order, as markdown.
- [Introduction](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/): Handlers are functions, routes are annotations, and h2o is the wire.
- [Quickstart](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/quickstart/): Build a hello route against the @release@ tag.
- [Getting started](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/getting-started/): Compiler support, GCC 16.2 with `-freflection`, Docker, and the hello image.
- [Overview](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/overview/): How a request becomes a response.
- [Requests](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/requests/): Path captures, query strings, JSON bodies, headers, and auth.
- [Responses](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/responses/): Status wrappers, JSON, static files, and cache headers.
- [State](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/state/): Values you manage on the app, including the optional Postgres library.
- [Fairings](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/fairings/): Hooks that run around every request, including logging and shields.
- [Testing](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/testing/): LocalClient drives the real pipeline in-process.
- [Configuration](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/configuration/): The Config object, timeouts, proxies, and TLS.
- [OpenAPI](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/openapi/): The document crocket writes from the handlers.
- [gRPC](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/grpc/): Unary RPC from the same annotated functions.
- [Deploying](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/deploying/): Images, health checks, and the drain on SIGTERM.
- [Scaling](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/scaling/): `crocket_saturation` for HPA or KEDA, and when more pods won't help.
- [From Express](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/migrate-express/): The users program beside an Express app.
- [From Spring Boot](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/migrate-spring/): The same users program beside a Spring Boot app.

## Examples

- [Quickstart](https://crocket.dev/guide/v0.5/quickstart/): The smallest program that listens.
- [Teapot](https://crocket.dev/teapot): A route that answers 418.

## Optional

- [Benchmarks](https://crocket.dev/benchmarks/): A production-track comparison of crocket against Rocket, Axum, Drogon, Fastify, hyper-express, Spring Boot, and FastAPI.

- [AI and assistants](https://crocket.dev/ai/): Why a crocket service stays reviewable when an assistant writes the first draft.
- [Blog](https://rambling.hashnode.dev/): Sean's writing.
- [Todo demo](https://todo.crocket.dev): A running app on this stack.
